name: Non-syndromic Complex Polydactyly

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Non-syndromic Complex Polydactyly

criteria.description: Presence of supernumerary digits involving hands and/or feet
Complex morphology of extra digits including bifid or triphalangeal phalanges
Lack of associated systemic or syndromic abnormalities
Positive family history of isolated polydactyly without syndromic features
Radiographic evidence confirming complex digital bone structure

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of supernumerary digits with complex morphology and absence of syndromic features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical supported by radiographic imaging; genetic testing may aid but is not mandatory.

imaging: Radiographs showing supernumerary digits with bifid or triphalangeal phalanges
Absence of bone abnormalities outside affected digits
genetic: Mutations in GLI3 gene reported in some familial cases
